sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:152

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:152:1
items.html: That the Vatikin would finish it before sunrise, and by means of this they did not need to read the Shema twice in the morning prayer: For the Mochin of the first intercourse, which was in the Shema upon the bed, do not depart until sunrise; therefore, since they advanced the Shema of the day, to read it before sunrise, they were able, in this Shema, to raise ZON at once as MAN to the upper AVI, in order to receive the Mochin of GAR. And they did not need to advance the Shema of the sacrifices in order to make her a vessel, for at that time the vessel still stood from the coupling of midnight. And this is what he says: “and by means of this they did not need to read the Shema twice in the morning prayer” — for they did not need the first intercourse.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:152:2
items.html: Other, new Mochin, superior to those that were at midnight: For at midnight, the coupling was not for the discernment of actual Mochin, but for the completion of the vessels, as above. But in the Shema of the day, the coupling is for the drawing of the actual GAR of Mochin: the VAK of these Mochin are drawn in the Shema of Yotzer, and their GAR are drawn in the blessing of the Patriarchs. And then ZON themselves are fit for coupling in the blessing of Sim Shalom.
